summary: Full regression for refactor batch M1/M3/M4 (members → routes/members.py, scheduler loops → services/scheduler.py, meals.py split → routes/meals/ package). 49/49 refactor regression tests PASS; 50/50 requested unit tests PASS; backend err log clean; frontend admin pages all load with 0 console errors. Pure refactor, no behavioral regressions detected.

minor.issue: PRE-EXISTING (not from refactor, confirmed by E1): without ?end= returns 500 via local_date_str(office=None). Frontend always passes start&end so no user impact. Still worth guarding with a 422 instead of 500.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/meals/__init__.py is a thin registrar that calls _reg_<area>(router, ctx) for each area — preserves the exact pre-refactor route order. Good pattern.
services/scheduler.py cleanly exposes close_stale_open_sessions / send_checkout_reminders / schedule_daily; server.py's lifespan shim just delegates. No functional drift.
routes/members.py: DELETE path correctly branches on is_super_admin — non-super admins get a queued correction, verified via admin2.test@example.com.
Suggest adding a smoke check in CI that imports routes/meals/__init__.py and asserts the 360-route table equals the pre-refactor snapshot to catch any future accidental reordering.
Known pre-existing: GET /api/meals/meal-calendar without ?end= returns 500 — should return 422; low priority, not in refactor scope.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor iter83 is fully regression-tested. rca of the issue: No regressions found. All three refactors (M1 members routes, M3 scheduler loops, M4 meals package split) are behaviour-preserving. Verified via: (a) 49 endpoint-level regression tests covering GETs across every meals area + members CRUD + archive hide/unhide + non-super-admin DELETE correction queue + vendor/item CRUD + SSE open; (b) 50 pure-function unit tests (kitchen_analytics_helpers, meals_today_pickers, weekly_photo_refresh, early_out_helper); (c) backend.err.log tail post-startup contains 0 tracebacks; (d) frontend smoke on /admin/masters, /meals, /admin/meals-calendar, /admin/meals-report, /admin/chefs-view all load with heading rendered and 0 console errors.
